stepExplanation:
Myopia is corrected with a **CONCAVE (diverging) lens**.

```
[CORRECTION OF MYOPIA]

    Distant object    CONCAVE    Corrected EYE
         *             LENS      __________
          \            /|\      /          \
           \          / | \    |            |
            \========/  |  \===|========X   |----Retina
           /        \   |  /   |    Image   |
          /          \ | /     |   now on   |
         *            \|/       \__retina__/
                    Diverges
                    light rays
```

How it works:
1. Concave lens DIVERGES (spreads out) light rays BEFORE they enter the eye
2. This compensates for the over-refraction by the cornea/lens
3. The focal point moves BACK onto the retina
4. Clear image is now formed on the retina
